author: HereIwas
body:
Okay.. so I was banned about 3 days ago for hacking, and for auto hitting, etc. 
But I really didn't hack, and it was my pure hands. It could be a misunderstanding to
the mods, that to their eyes it seemed like hacking, but it was my hands, it wasn't hack.
And to recover my memory, the place I was banned was Control The Hill, and it was a place
where I could show my pvp skills purely, and I could see that there were some online 
moderators playing there too. They were not that bad, but I was not bad too. And once I killed
one guy in two hits, and maybe that could start the suspicion. But that guy should have been
in low health, because that guy died in two critical hits. And I really want to play this server again
because it's one of the server that I enjoy, and like to play on. And I am not angry to the moderators
for banning me because everyone makes mistake. I hope this misunderstanding could be solved
and being unbanned from this server and playing again will be a great happiness to me.
